confidence.rationale: Observed once in Macro-Mission 01; no external authorization evidence was available.

decision_rules: Classify HTTP read-only methods separately from identity, permission, ownership, and exposure authorization.

evidence_refs.claim: Read-only HTTP methods did not imply safe exposure.
Canonical contracts existed without proven legacy route coverage.

failure_modes: Calling a GET route authorized merely because it does not mutate product state.
preconditions: A route method is known but identity, owner, exposure, and permission evidence may be incomplete.
procedure: Inspect canonical permission and confirmation evidence.
Keep authorization unresolved when the chain is not demonstrated.
recovery: Retain the route as unknown or not demonstrated and name the next evidence producer.
stop_conditions: Do not infer read authorization from method naming or absence of a write call.
summary: Read-only transport semantics do not establish read authorization or safe exposure.
title: Read-only method is not read authorization
validation: Macro 01 route reconnaissance and canonical coverage guards.
